metrics.label: Field-goal percentage
metrics.definition: 100 × SUM(FGM) / SUM(FGA)

metrics.label: Three-point percentage
metrics.definition: 100 × SUM(3PM) / SUM(3PA)

metrics.label: Free-throw percentage
metrics.definition: 100 × SUM(FTM) / SUM(FTA)

metrics.label: Two-point percentage
metrics.definition: 100 × (SUM(FGM) − SUM(3PM)) / (SUM(FGA) − SUM(3PA))

metrics.label: Effective field-goal percentage
metrics.definition: 100 × (SUM(FGM) + 0.5 × SUM(3PM)) / SUM(FGA)

metrics.label: True shooting percentage
metrics.definition: 100 × SUM(PTS) / (2 × (SUM(FGA) + 0.44 × SUM(FTA)))

metrics.label: Relative true shooting
metrics.formula: Player TS% minus league TS%, in percentage points. League baseline uses all recorded games in the date and season-type window, independent of display filters.
metrics.definition: Player TS% minus league TS%, in percentage points. League baseline uses all recorded games in the date and season-type window, independent of display filters.

metrics.label: Three-point attempt rate
metrics.definition: 100 × SUM(3PA) / SUM(FGA)

metrics.label: Free-throw attempt rate
metrics.definition: 100 × SUM(FTA) / SUM(FGA)

metrics.label: Box-score turnover rate
metrics.formula: 100 × SUM(TOV) / (SUM(FGA) + 0.44 × SUM(FTA) + SUM(TOV)); this is a box-score approximation.
metrics.definition: 100 × SUM(TOV) / (SUM(FGA) + 0.44 × SUM(FTA) + SUM(TOV)); this is a box-score approximation.

metrics.label: Assist-to-turnover ratio
metrics.formula: SUM(AST) / SUM(TOV); unavailable when no turnovers are recorded.
metrics.definition: SUM(AST) / SUM(TOV); unavailable when no turnovers are recorded.

metrics.label: Points per field-goal attempt
metrics.definition: SUM(PTS) / SUM(FGA), including free-throw points.

metrics.label: Free-throw share of scoring attempts
metrics.definition: 100 × (0.44 × SUM(FTA)) / (SUM(FGA) + 0.44 × SUM(FTA))

metrics.label: Two-point share of points
metrics.definition: 100 × 2 × (SUM(FGM) − SUM(3PM)) / SUM(PTS)

metrics.label: Three-point share of points
metrics.definition: 100 × 3 × SUM(3PM) / SUM(PTS)

metrics.label: Free-throw share of points
metrics.definition: 100 × SUM(FTM) / SUM(PTS)

metrics.label: Two-pointers made
metrics.definition: SUM(FGM) − SUM(3PM)

metrics.label: Two-pointers attempted
metrics.definition: SUM(FGA) − SUM(3PA)

metrics.label: True shooting attempts
metrics.definition: SUM(FGA) + 0.44 × SUM(FTA)
